basis: Paper. Simulated fills at the next session's open from daily bars; no order is placed. Price return only, against a price index. Not the published record.

rules.entry: next session's open + 10 bp slippage; quantity rounds down
rules.exit: the open of the first session on or after day 365, − 10 bp
rules.costs: delivery-equity schedule: brokerage, STT, exchange, SEBI, GST, stamp, DP
rules.dividends: not included (price return), as for the benchmark
rules.ranking: trading-dashboard's published Magic Formula rank, read as is
